replies.author: Tempus
replies.body:
Owen.
Factions may be awsome, but you can already play it on so many servers.
Avicus may not be perfect, but we try our best - We have user created maps almost always, Elimination is a twist on Hunger Games (too bad no one plays ¬.¬), and our community is nice - and factions would pretty much trash that. With factions, so many players would form rivalries for no reason other than "He killed me T-T", and that would truly put Avicus onto the chopping block - hackers, scammers, trolls run rampant.

I really feel like Avicus is better without factions, though maybe a survival gamemode like SMP or Skyblock or Skygrid would be a great way to introduce people to our server.
